best_for: Notion users on Mac or Windows who juggle Google, Outlook or iCloud calendars and want their Notion deadlines and booking links in the same view.

points.title: Free to download
points.text: Notion's product page offers Notion Calendar for free and lists no paid tier for it.

points.title: Three calendar services plus Notion
points.text: It connects Google, iCloud and Microsoft Outlook or Microsoft 365 calendars, and shows any Notion database that has a date property. iCloud needs an app-specific password from your Apple account. You can link only one Notion account, but several calendars and workspaces.

points.title: Booking and time zones
points.text: You can share a scheduling link with your free slots, view your day across several time zones, and join meetings from the menu bar. Google Meet, Zoom and custom meeting links are supported.

points.title: Gaps to know about
points.text: Notion says performance may drop past five calendars. You can't subscribe to a new calendar inside the app, travel time isn't supported, and Focus and Out of Office events work only with Google Workspace work or school accounts.

points.title: Windows trails the Mac
points.text: The Windows listing is at 1.133.0 while macOS is at 1.144.0. The Windows installer is per-user and x64 only, with no Arm64 build listed. The Mac app needs macOS 13 or later and comes for Intel and Apple silicon.

points.title: Few versions to fall back on
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 8 versions. macOS lists only the current release, so an older Mac build needs another source.
